subject.title: fix(mcp): bound CLI OAuth login through guarded fetch timeout

question: Should configured MCP request deadlines apply across the full finite OAuth lifecycle for CLI login and bearer projection?
rationale: The code and proof support the fix, but merging intentionally changes operator-visible availability for slow OAuth endpoints and token bodies, so the assigned maintainer must accept that contract.

options.title: Accept configured OAuth deadlines
options.body: Merge the exact head and treat existing MCP request timeouts as the deadline for finite discovery, registration, token, and refresh operations.

options.title: Define separate OAuth semantics
options.body: Pause only if authentication should use a distinct deadline rather than the existing MCP request timeout.

recommendation.title: Accept configured OAuth deadlines
recommendation.body: Merge the exact head and treat existing MCP request timeouts as the deadline for finite discovery, registration, token, and refresh operations.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the operator workflow, authored the final head adjustment, and are assigned on the live PR.
